_comment: Readings CMUdict does not carry, for words an English reader meets in the
King James Bible: archaic machinery (saith, wherefore, threescore, 'an
hungered'), worship and antiquity words (sepulchres, phylacteries,
cherubims), and the names. The target is the ordinary English reading-room
pronunciation, not Hebrew or Greek scholarship.
A patch, not a fork: createFrontend({ readings }) consults this after the
dictionary and before the neural model, so nothing CMUdict answers is
touched, and tools/speak.js loads every json in this folder by default.
Built by ~/sano-bible/build/readings.py from a scan of all 31,102 verses
for words the front end could not read from the dictionary. ARPAbet only,
exactly one primary stress per entry, never a word CMUdict already has.
